reason: Searched for Northwest Ridge trip reports and opened stevensong (no report reached) and sverdina Big_Four1 (a Dry Creek attempt). The only NW Ridge mention is a 2007 SummitPost climbers' log seen as a snippet (403). No opened source describes this route.

The same Big Four searches (AAJ north face notes, sverdina, stevensong, turns-all-year) turned up nothing on the Tower Route beyond a SummitPost access note (403). No opened source gives its line, timing or descent.

A search for a Hester Lake southwest-ridge ascent found only a turns-all-year line noting a possible southwest-side descent into the Hester bowl, plus Hester Lake approach notes for Mount Price. The SummitPost 'Southwest Ridge' results are for an Idaho peak. No report of this route was found.

A search for East Buttress reports returned only Northeast Ridge and South Route reports and the SummitPost peak page (403), which is the only description of the East Buttress (from Wing Lake, gully system, class 3-4). There is no second source.

A search on the north ridge from the Middle Fork found only first-ascent history (Wikipedia, June 1971) and Yellowleaf trips from the Chikamin/Iceberg side via the NE ridge. No source describes the north ridge climb or the river crossing.

A search for a Harts Pass/PCT ascent found PCT and Castle Pass hike pages and SummitPost log snippets (403) describing the west ridge from Castle Pass and a south-face descent. Neither matches this row's Castle Creek basin, northeast gully and notch line, and no opened source gives timing for it.

No new search, since the budget went to routes with better odds. Earlier work found only first-ascent material from a party approaching from Canada, and nothing on the lawful Ross Lake / Freezeout Creek approach.

A search for Chair-Bryant traverse reports found only the OpenBeta entry (the stg.openbeta.io page returns 404 on fetch), a 2004 CascadeClimbers note (403) on going Bryant to Chair, and Chair Peak circumnavigation ski reports. No opened source gives timing or a day structure.
No new search. Earlier work found no source describing the East Face (the row's own descent is 'presumed'), and northern Pickets material covers other routes.
No new search. The only known source is the 1988 AAJ note, which gives no approach, camps or descent. A second source 404'd earlier and SummitPost returns 403.

No new search. The AAJ 2009 and Alpinist 2008 first-ascent reports describe the route, but give no mileage, gain or hours for the two approach days or the walk-out, so those days would carry no sourced figure. The two also disagree on length (29 vs 25 pitches).

A search for a 'northeast face' route on Fortress found the East Route, the East Ridge and Chiwawa Mountain material (SummitPost 403, wenatcheeoutdoors, AAJ Chiwawa 'Intravenous'). Nothing names or describes a Northeast Face line on Fortress.

A search for North Peak South Ridge found only a Wikipedia route list (class 3-4 South Ridge, ambiguous between peaks). I opened the stevensong report: it climbs the Northwest Ridge from Manning Park in one day, not this route. The other reports cover the NE ridge/buttress, the SW buttress and the north face.

A search for Tank Lakes / northeast shoulder found Alpine Lakes High Route reports (WTA 403, climberkyle, Lemke) and Yellowleaf traverses. These mention a narrow NE ridge passage and other lines but describe no ascent of the northeast shoulder with camps or per-day figures.

A search for Crowder via Easy Ridge found Abegg's Mystery Ridge enchainment (Crowder's southwest flank reached from Wild Lake, to the south) and a climberkyle traverse that bypassed Crowder on its west side. The other hits were CascadeClimbers (403). Nothing climbs this route from the row's Easy Ridge / Perfect Pass approach.

A search for 'Harniss' chute with Mount Lincoln and Flapjack Lakes found no mention of the chute anywhere. The hits were Flapjack Lakes hike notes, a Mildred Lakes approach to Lincoln, and an unrelated Lincoln Peak (Baker). The route name could not be confirmed.
